subject: DPA redlines: SCCs sequencing & Order Form handoff
messages:
From: Miriam Torres <miriam.torres@vanchor.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanchor Legal <legal@vanchor.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Vanchor DPA redlines + SCCs sequencing for Order Form

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited about the fit. Attached are Vanchor's proposed redlines to Redwood's standard DPA and a short note on SCCs we need included for our EU operations. High level items:

- We modified the SCCs Annex to include an auditor access clause (Section 3.2).
- We propose explicit processor role language for your dedicated deployment (we've underlined "processor" responsibilities).
- We included a short transfer impact addendum that would apply until the SCCs are executed (see page 6).

Could you confirm (a) whether Redwood can accept the SCCs revisions as redlined or prefers to handle them as a separate execution step, and (b) what evidence you can provide (SOC 2 Type II date, KMS options, export controls) for procurement?

We'd like to get a clean order form signed by the end of next week if possible. If useful, happy to do a 20-minute legal handoff call with your team.

Attachments: Vanchor_DPA_redlines_2025-07-28.docx (redline)

Best,
Miriam Torres
Head of Legal Operations
Vanchor

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Miriam Torres <miriam.torres@vanchor.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 12:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Vanchor DPA redlines + SCCs sequencing for Order Form

Miriam — thanks for the redlines and the clear note. Looping in our legal (Laura) and contracts/sales (Ben) plus security (Kim) to triage. Internal plan I propose: 

1) Legal will do a quick pass for mandatory exceptions (SCCs language and controller/processor mapping).
2) Security will confirm the evidence list (SOC 2 scope, KMS/HSM options, export-control constraints).
3) Sales will update the Order Form and propose a signing timeline (Ben).

Laura/Kim/Ben — can you review the attached redline and surface the top 3 blockers within 24-48 hours? If there are major SCCs objections, we'll aim to treat the SCCs annex as a separate execution (transfer addendum) to avoid delaying the commercial signature.

Miriam — we'll confirm next steps by tomorrow EOD and propose a 20-min legal sync if needed.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 10:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Vanchor DPA redlines + SCCs sequencing for Order Form — initial legal triage

Aditya / team — I reviewed Miriam's redlines and here are the priority items that will determine pathing: 

1) SCCs Annex — Vanchor's draft adds auditor access language that expands our obligations (page 3, para 2). We can accept a narrow auditor access clause if it's limited to "reasonable, pre-notified audits" and scoped to security controls. If they insist on broad "on-site" audits, that's an exception.

2) Roles (Controller vs Processor) — Their redline re-labels some of our hosting obligations as controller duties for dedicated deployments. We need to confirm facts with infra (Kim) — if we retain key routing/control, we should remain processor for the service.

3) Transfer impact addendum — The proposed interim addendum is OK in principle but needs a clear trigger/expiry and fallback (e.g., execution of SCCs within 90 days). If SCCs are still outstanding at signature, we recommend a limited addendum and explicit remediation commitments.

Next steps I recommend (for decision):
- Kim: confirm SOC2 date, KMS/HSM availability, and whether we can accept the proposed auditor language (by EOD).
- Ben: if legal flags narrow exceptions only, please propose a commercial carve (pricing/escrow) and update HubSpot deal notes.
- I'll prepare a short comment set (attached) highlighting alternative language we can offer and flagging any non-starters.

Attachment: RWD_comments_vanchor_dpa.pdf (internal comment set)

I'll be on a short call at 15:00 but can jump on a 20-min sync after.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Miriam Torres <miriam.torres@vanchor.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 15:46:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Vanchor DPA redlines + SCCs sequencing for Order Form — proposed MAP and timeline

Miriam — thanks for the patience. Quick update from our side and proposed mutual action plan so procurement can move forward: 

- Legal (Laura) has provided a comment set. We can accept a scoped auditor access clause (pre-notified, security-focused) and a 90-day transfer addendum window conditional on SCC execution.
- Security (Kim) confirmed SOC 2 Type II (report dated 2025-06-15) and KMS options for dedicated deployments — details sent to Laura offline.
- Sales will publish an updated Order Form with a note that SCCs are pending execution; the Order Form will include the transfer addendum as an exhibit to allow signature now.

Proposed MAP (dates in UTC):
1) 2025-07-31: Laura to send proposed replacement language for the SCCs auditor paragraph.
2) 2025-08-01: Ben to send Order Form v2 (redline) and HubSpot update.
3) 2025-08-04: Target for commercial signature; SCCs execution tracked separately with 90-day window.

Links: HubSpot deal https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345 (VANCH-4521) | DocuSign template: https://app.docusign.com/templates/FAKE_TEMPLATE_ID

Attachments: OrderForm_Vanchor_Redline_2025-07-30.pdf

If that timeline works for you, Miriam, we'll push the Order Form and kick DocuSign on Monday morning. If you prefer SCCs to be signed before the order form, let us know and we can pause — but that will likely push the commercial close by 2–3 weeks.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
